description: Hand-authored appsec-review/codeql-graph-export/1 objects over source/app/*.java for the java graph-export pack. They are a deliberately chosen subset of what the pack would export (implicit super() constructor calls, class initializers and some intermediate path nodes are omitted), written to exercise the Java cases; they are not a CodeQL recording. bqrs_sha256 values are SHA-256 of the text 'hand-authored synthetic bqrs <query_id>'. The manifest pack hashes are computed locally over the pack tree and columns.json at authoring time; they are not the host-locked hashes.
